brutal_cinematic_prompt:
Redesign this SIX-PANEL cinematic atlas for a fantasy game aimed at ADULTS. Keep exact TWO columns by THREE rows, all six landscape panels equal size. Reference1 existing cinematic layout and clan/world identity; references2 and3 NEW adult character portraits with differentiated faces, these replace the old cute faces. Reference4 player sprite is identity/clothing reference. Retain our vivid outlined painted game aesthetic, but use mature graphic-fantasy composition, adult natural head-to-body proportions, threatening expressions, weight, ash, blood, damage and CONSEQUENCES. No children's-animation Hobbit feeling, no cute jovial dwarfs, no giant round baby heads, no glossy photorealistic 3D. Ogres are enormous powerful upright adults, with the physical proportions of massive strongmen rather than small squat cartoons. Warm hearth light can coexist with savage people.

TOP LEFT — BURNING EMBERHIDE: a war-torn riverside camp, canvas tents burning fiercely, an overturned huge wagon, crushed possessions and the plainly visible fallen bodies of ADULT armed Ogre defenders. Blood stains the mud and an abandoned axe. Survivors dragging one wounded adult behind a wagon. Smoke and cold blue dusk, an oppressive sense of loss. Young red-bearded player in cream fur and red cloth in foreground, axe in his hand, horrified and furious, not cheerfully posing. No children.

TOP RIGHT — FALL OF GORUND: unmistakably HROTHGAR (dark-red iron-gray heavy beard, broad angular wedge face, high nose, eyebrow scar, black fur) stands above the fallen chief's enormous cloth-covered body and holds up GORUND'S SEVERED HEAD by its long white braids as a brutal public proof of conquest. Gorund has slate-gray skin, white twin-braid beard, huge worn tusks, eyes closed. The severing is clearly implied by the separated head, blood on Hrothgar's fist, the neck edge mostly hidden by the huge beard, and blood on the ground. NO exposed organs or anatomical cross-section closeup. Hrothgar's expression is grimly matter-of-fact, not gleeful. His iron maul rests at his side. This is a savage political act with weight, not a comedy or a gore showcase. All characters adults.

MIDDLE LEFT — CHALLENGE: enormous Hrothgar, blood on black-fur mantle and iron maul, towers over the young player whose axe is ready; the player's expression is fury, grief and stubborn courage. Broken family camp behind. Adult mature faces, menacing confrontation, no smiles.

MIDDLE RIGHT — MERCY: player on one knee in churned mud, battered, bloody lip and bruised face, broken leather strap; Hrothgar slams his maul into ground inches beside the player's head, deliberately sparing him. The chief's expression calmly assessing. Violence feels forceful, consequential and frightening. No anatomical gore, player survives.

BOTTOM LEFT — WANDERING HOST: a tremendous nomadic caravan of huge red and cream canvas wagons drawn by woolly slate-armored rhino beasts across the northern mountain wilderness. Rugged mature Ogre adults, wounded Emberhide survivors among the procession, old giant chief in front. Rich green pines, blue mountain light, traditional painted game detail.

BOTTOM RIGHT — FIRST INDEPENDENT HEARTH: quiet battered young player lighting his own small fire by his newly earned wagon at dusk, a healed cheek scar, worn axe nearby. Reflective hard-earned peace, still a powerful adult. Warm flame, cool mountains. Preserve cozy hearth possibility without undoing the preceding brutality.

No lettering, captions, logos, decorative margins or overlays. Do not merge scenes. All clothing stays intact except practical battle damage. Wide cinematic composition in every panel. Square atlas 1536x1536 or larger.
